decisions.reason: As a bread close to the core assortment that remained on offer after launch, it likely met a satisfactory aspiration level and a growing industry gives enough slack to keep it.
This pastry fits the firm's established craft base and its continued presence after launch suggests acceptable performance, so management would have little reason to replace it.
Although newer and therefore somewhat less proven, it is a core-style bread using existing capabilities, so with no sign of firm distress it is more likely to be retained than cut.
As a flagship seasonal product with a dedicated page and a gold award, it clearly exceeds aspiration levels and is very unlikely to be removed.
Its gold award points to performance above comparable standards, and despite some overlap with other stollen products it is still likely to stay in the range.
